title: Summit Tier Requalification: Thresholds and Tier Reached
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets the tier a requalification records from the counted qualifying dollars of the calendar year.

**Counted qualifying dollars.** The count is the qualifying dollars posted on the membership for the calendar year, as the membership's qualifying-dollar total shows them.

**Tier reached.** A member qualifies for the highest tier whose qualifying-dollar threshold the counted qualifying dollars reach, and never falls below the tier already held by this count. Summit Chairman stays reachable by invitation only: a member holding Summit Chairman keeps it, and no count gives it.

| Tier | Threshold compared (USD) |
|---|---|
| Summit Silver | 4500 |
| Summit Gold | 9000 |
| Summit Platinum | 14000 |
| Summit Diamond | 26000 |

Counted qualifying dollars below 4500 USD reach no elite tier and give Summit Member, unless the tier already held is higher. A threshold is reached when the count equals it or exceeds it.

### Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Tier held | Counted qualifying dollars (USD) | Highest threshold reached | Tier recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 4499.99 | none | Summit Member |
| Summit Member | 9000.00 | Summit Gold | Summit Gold |
| Summit Silver | 14500.00 | Summit Platinum | Summit Platinum |
| Summit Gold | 5000.00 | Summit Silver | Summit Gold (not below the tier held) |
| Summit Chairman | 30000.00 | Summit Diamond | Summit Chairman |
